accepted.s: Which of the following is the nodal agency of the Government of Andhra Pradesh for IT procurement, cybersecurity, digital certificates and Aadhaar-related services?
o: AP State Cyber Security Operations Centre (APCSOC)
accepted.x: APTS, established in 1986, is the nodal agency for IT procurement, cybersecurity, digital certificates and Aadhaar-related services. It functions as a self-financing organisation.
accepted.tq: Use the role-based distinction between closely related e-governance bodies.
accepted.sec: Innovation and e-governance bodies - year and role  [APPSC]

accepted.s: AP Technology Services Limited (APTS) was established in which year?
accepted.x: AP Technology Services Limited was established in 1986 and functions as a self-financing IT services organisation of Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Check the precise establishment year rather than confusing it with the years of other initiatives.
accepted.sec: Innovation and e-governance bodies - year and role  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the institutions associated with information technology in Andhra Pradesh:
1. APEITA implements IT and Electronics policies and promotes investment.
2. APSAC is associated with remote sensing, GIS and drones.
3. IIDT, located at Tirupati, focuses on AI, VLSI and cyber skills.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. APEITA handles policy implementation and investment promotion, APSAC works in remote sensing, GIS and drones, and IIDT at Tirupati develops AI, VLSI and cybersecurity skills.
accepted.tq: Verify each institutional role separately before selecting the coded combination.
accepted.sec: Innovation and e-governance bodies - year and role  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched?
o: APEITA — Implementation of IT and Electronics policies and investment promotion
APTS — Administration of remote sensing and GIS programmes
ITE&C Department — Parent department for IT, electronics and communications
accepted.x: APTS is responsible for IT procurement, cybersecurity, digital certificates and Aadhaar-related services. Remote sensing and GIS are associated with APSAC, not APTS.
accepted.tq: Find the institution whose assigned function has been swapped with that of a neighbouring body.
accepted.sec: Innovation and e-governance bodies - year and role  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Innovation and Startup Policy (4.0) of Andhra Pradesh for 2024–29 was issued by which department in April 2025?
accepted.x: The Innovation and Startup Policy (4.0), 2024–29, was issued in April 2025 by the ITE&C (Promotions) Department.
accepted.tq: Apply the 'which department issued the policy?' trap to distinguish the parent department from a specialised division.
accepted.sec: Innovation and e-governance bodies - year and role  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following incentives is associated with the Andhra Pradesh Innovation and Startup Policy (4.0), 2024–29?
1. A ₹22-crore RTIH-SIDBI Seed Fund
2. Up to ₹20 crore of AIF seed equity
3. A target of 20,000 start-ups and one lakh jobs in five years
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: The policy provides for a ₹22-crore RTIH-SIDBI Seed Fund, up to ₹20 crore of AIF seed equity, and targets 20,000 start-ups and one lakh jobs in five years.
accepted.tq: Separate financial incentives from numerical targets and test all policy provisions together.
accepted.sec: Innovation and e-governance bodies - year and role  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The target phrase “One Family, One Entrepreneur” is associated with which objective of Andhra Pradesh’s Innovation and Startup Policy?
o: Establishing one cyber-security centre in every district
Moving one lakh government servers to the State Data Centre
Providing one digital certificate to every household
Creating 20,000 start-ups and one lakh jobs in five years
accepted.x: “One Family, One Entrepreneur” is linked with the policy target of creating 20,000 start-ups and one lakh jobs in five years.
accepted.tq: Connect the slogan with its precise quantitative target.
accepted.sec: Innovation and e-governance bodies - year and role  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following programmes is associated with the AP Innovation Society and the Ratan Tata Innovation Hub?
o: GIS Hub, Land Hub, Entity Hub and People Hub
SPARK, Catalyst, Velocity Labs and Innotribe
accepted.x: SPARK, Catalyst, Velocity Labs and Innotribe are programmes associated with the AP Innovation Society and the Ratan Tata Innovation Hub.
accepted.tq: Use list recognition while rejecting lists belonging to e-governance or NIC-AP systems.
accepted.sec: Innovation and e-governance bodies - year and role  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
With reference to the Ratan Tata Innovation Hub (RTIH), consider the following statements:
1. Its hub is located at Amaravati.
2. It has spokes at Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Tirupati, Rajahmundry and Anantapuramu.
3. It was established in August 2025.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. RTIH was established in August 2025, has its hub at Amaravati, and has spokes at the five places listed.
accepted.tq: Check the date, headquarters and complete location list independently.
accepted.sec: Innovation and e-governance bodies - year and role  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched with a NIC-AP solution?
o: MEDHAS — Medical Education and Health Administrative System
accepted.x: MEDHAS stands for Medical Education and Health Administrative System. D-Krishi is associated with e-seed, CARD with registration, and e-PDS with rice cards.
accepted.tq: Start with the acronym whose expansion directly identifies its function and eliminate swapped roles.

accepted.s: MEDHAS was built by NIC-APSC for which institution?
o: Andhra Pradesh State Skill Development Corporation
Dr NTR University of Health Sciences
Acharya N. G. Ranga Agricultural University
accepted.x: MEDHAS was built by NIC-APSC for Dr NTR University of Health Sciences at Vijayawada, which was established in 1986 as India’s first health university.
accepted.tq: Identify the user institution rather than the agency that developed the software.

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
accepted.x: APMCORS is associated with the Andhra Pradesh Public Distribution and Agricultural Market-related computerised system indicated in the source list, whereas police automation is associated with APOLIS.
accepted.tq: Detect the role assigned to a different digital platform.

accepted.s: Which of the following best describes e-Pragati?
o: A whole-of-government digital platform based on State Enterprise Architecture
A district-level portal exclusively for land registration
A central government fund for start-ups
accepted.x: e-Pragati is Andhra Pradesh’s whole-of-government digital platform based on State Enterprise Architecture. It interconnects departmental e-governance systems.
accepted.tq: Select the option that captures the broad institutional scope rather than a single department’s function.
accepted.sec: e-Pragati - launch, CM, pillars and packages  [APPSC]

accepted.s: How many packages and projects were included in the original e-Pragati framework?
accepted.x: The e-Pragati framework consisted of 14 packages and 72 projects across 33 departments.
accepted.tq: Read the paired quantitative figures together instead of selecting a familiar-looking single number.
accepted.sec: e-Pragati - launch, CM, pillars and packages  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The original e-Pragati framework covered how many departments?
accepted.x: e-Pragati was designed with 14 packages and 72 projects across 33 departments.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the department count from the related package and project counts.
accepted.sec: e-Pragati - launch, CM, pillars and packages  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the core data hubs of e-Pragati?
accepted.x: The core e-Pragati data hubs are People Hub, Land Hub, Entity Hub, GIS Hub and IoT Hub. Finance Hub is not included in the listed core hubs.
accepted.tq: Find the extra item in a named institutional list.
accepted.sec: e-Pragati - launch, CM, pillars and packages  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about e-Pragati:
1. It seeks to interconnect all e-governance systems through a whole-of-government approach.
2. It integrates departments such as Revenue, Registration, Transport and Municipal services through a single window.
3. It is built on the Seva model.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. e-Pragati interconnects departmental systems, provides a single-window interface for several departments and follows the Seva model.
accepted.tq: Test the platform’s architecture, service integration and operating model together.
accepted.sec: e-Pragati - launch, CM, pillars and packages  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The stated governance objective of e-Pragati is to provide governance that is:
accepted.x: The stated objective of e-Pragati is faceless, paperless and cashless governance.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact official phrase rather than a broad paraphrase.
accepted.sec: e-Pragati - launch, CM, pillars and packages  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes a later administrative development relating to e-Pragati?
o: 33 departmental servers were moved to the State Data Centre and 101 services were added in August 2025.
72 departmental servers were moved to the State Data Centre and 14 services were added in February 2025.
101 departmental servers were moved to the State Data Centre and 45 additional services were added in February 2026.
101 departmental servers were moved to the National Data Centre and 45 services were withdrawn in February 2026.
accepted.x: The e-Pragati Authority moved 101 departmental servers to the State Data Centre, and 45 more services were added in February 2026.
accepted.tq: Check both the server count and the later service addition; altered figures are the trap.
accepted.sec: e-Pragati - launch, CM, pillars and packages  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched in the context of e-Pragati’s associated systems?
o: APOLIS — Police automation; AP State Portal — State portal services
APOLIS — Agricultural seed distribution; AP State Portal — Remote sensing
APOLIS — Medical education; AP State Portal — Cybersecurity operations
APOLIS — Registration services; AP State Portal — Rice-card management
accepted.x: The e-Pragati Authority built APOLIS for police automation and the AP State Portal for state portal services.
accepted.tq: Match each named system to its functional domain before comparing the answer codes.
accepted.sec: e-Pragati - launch, CM, pillars and packages  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Assertion (A): e-Pragati adopts a whole-of-government approach to digital governance.
Reason (R): It interconnects departmental e-governance systems and uses common core datasets such as the People Hub, Land Hub, Entity Hub, GIS Hub and IoT Hub.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
accepted.x: Both the assertion and reason are true. Interconnection of departmental systems and use of common data hubs directly explain the whole-of-government character of e-Pragati.
accepted.tq: Test whether the reason explains the architectural feature stated in the assertion.
accepted.sec: e-Pragati - launch, CM, pillars and packages  [APPSC]
